idea-plugin.name: Device Modeler
idea-plugin.description:
Device models (.devm) in CLion and the other JetBrains IDEs: hierarchical state machines and structure files (components, data-flow ports, subsystems, systems, threads, connections). The Device Modeler web app (text editor, PlantUML-style state machine diagram, internal-block structure diagram, properties, simulation, export, C++ generation) runs in an editor tab, working on the IDE's document of the file, next to the IDE's text editor.
  • Editor with the views Text, Text and Diagram and Diagram (JCEF): the state machine diagram for state machines, the structure diagram for structure files
  • Problems of the model in the text editor and in the Problems tool window (also of closed files, with the devm command line tool)
  • Structure view, navigation from problems and structure into the diagram
  • Generate C++ of state machines (configured by devm.gen.json or the settings)
  • Undo, redo, copy, paste, find and save shortcuts in the diagram editor; dark theme of the IDE
  • Highlighting, comments and braces of .devm and .devmtest files
  • With the plugin LSP4IJ: the Device Modeler language server (devm lsp) in the text editor – diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition / declaration / type definition into C/C++ headers and other models, document links, formatting, structure, folding, rename and semantic highlighting

action.description: Generate the C++ code of the state machine (configured by devm.gen.json or the Device Modeler settings)
Validate all models (state machines and structure files) of the project with the devm command line tool
